fusions.name: Stingers Abreast
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbed tines at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pitched Hive
fusions.desc: Pitches a hive off the tines that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it. Everything struck is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dole of Honey
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pollen Baskets
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
